subject: Trial MAP checkpoint — milestone ownership and acceptance runway
messages:
From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finera.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint: data ingestion blocker + ask for runbook

Hi team,

Quick status from Finera on the POC: the ingestion job we handed you on Thursday is failing intermittently during schema validation (see attached integrations_log.csv). The devs hit a parsing error that only shows up with a subset of records — we've attached a small sample in finera-sample-errors.txt.

This is blocking our ability to run the acceptance suite on Thursday as planned. Can you confirm:
- Who on Redwood will own immediate triage (name + pager)?
- What the proposed short-term mitigation is (workaround to complete suite runs this week)?
- Where you want us to drop new failing samples (S3 path or email)?

We'd also appreciate a one-page runbook from Redwood that lists milestone owners, acceptance criteria mapping, and the proposed canary window so our procurement/legal teams can align timelines.

Thanks — can we sync 30m Tuesday morning if we can’t resolve by EOD Monday?

Alex
Alex Tan
Product Lead, Integrations
Finera

Attachments: integrations_log.csv, finera-sample-errors.txt
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finera.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: data ingestion blocker + ask for runbook

Alex — thanks for the signal and the artifacts, that helped. Quick update from our side after an initial pass:

Summary:
- Root cause likely a timestamp format edge case in the ingestion shim. Karthik has reproduced locally.
- Short-term mitigation: drop to lenient schema mode + a filter to quarantine malformed rows; will let your suite run to completion.

Action owners & ETA:
1) Karthik Iyer — triage & mitigation (apply quarantine filter + patch) — ETA: Wed 05/26 14:00 PT.
2) Neha Kapoor — acceptance criteria alignment + smoke tests (will validate suite against patched data) — ETA: Thu 05/27 11:00 PT.
3) Sean Gallagher — runbook & rollout notes (one-page PDF with milestone owners, acceptance matrix, canary window) — ETA: Fri 05/28 16:00 PT.
4) Marissa Cole — procurement/contract liaison for any timeline slips — standing point of contact for legal/ops.

Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Functional: end-to-end pipeline completes for the sample dataset with zero fatal errors.
- Quality: less than 0.1% records quarantined (for the POC dataset).
- Performance: average end-to-end latency < 450ms per request in the acceptance suite (p95 < 900ms).

Runbook location (draft): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_runbook
I’ve attached the first-pass runbook (redwood-map-runbook-v1.pdf). Please review and flag any mismatches to the acceptance criteria above.

If the mitigation works we can keep the original acceptance window (canary next Tue 06/01). If not, we'll propose a 1-week slide and update procurement.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-map-runbook-v1.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finera.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: data ingestion blocker + ask for runbook

Quick clarifications on acceptance criteria — + proposed test matrix: 

1) Quarantine threshold — Finera: is 0.1% acceptable for you, or do you want 0.01% for the POC? Alex please confirm.
2) Latency SLO — Sean’s draft uses avg < 450ms / p95 < 900ms. For the POC we recommend p95 < 1s but want to capture p50/p90 as well in the runbook.

Next steps for validation: Karthik, please attach the failing-case repro steps and the exact patch you plan to push. Alex — please ensure any new failing files are dropped to the S3 path: s3://finera-poc/failing-samples/ so Neha and Karthik can pick them up.

I’ll run the acceptance checklist against the patched pipeline and post results to the HubSpot deal thread.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — short operational note and confirmed next steps: 

- Karthik confirmed the mitigation went out at 05/26 13:40 PT and the quarantine filter dropped malformed rows; Neha ran a smoke pass 05/27 and handed back a green/red matrix.
- Alex: per your note, Finera dropped new failing samples to s3://finera-poc/failing-samples/ on 05/27; those were consumed by the triage run.
- Canary window: Tue 01 Jun 2027, 09:00–12:00 PT (we will keep a rollback until 15:00 PT). Please confirm availability for a 30m monitoring call immediately after the window.
- Procurement impact: if any further slide is needed we will notify HubSpot deal owner and propose a 7-day extension. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/REDFT-319

Action roster (final):
- Karthik Iyer — mitigation & canary monitoring (owner).
- Neha Kapoor — acceptance checklist lead (run acceptance tests; post results).
- Sean Gallagher — customer escalation & exec updates.
- Marissa Cole — procurement/contract contact (manage timeline impacts).

Thanks — can everyone ACK on this thread so Finera can lock calendar invites?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
